title: Nexus Corp Onboarding: The Greenest Supply Chain by 2030

rounds.title: Transparency: Map the Green Supply Chain

task.goal: Build a shared, honest picture of how transparent information can help Nexus move toward the greenest supply chain by 2030.
instructions: Sketch a shipment’s journey from origin to customer.
Mark where emissions, delays, or other sustainability impacts are visible and where information is missing.
Suggest one practical way to make a missing piece of information clearer.
Label each idea with its stage of the journey so the host can quickly track themes across rooms.

checklist.label: We identified at least one information gap affecting sustainability.
We suggested a way to make that gap more transparent.

activities.title: Where would transparency help most?
activities.description: Privately name one point in a shipment’s journey where better information could help Nexus make a greener decision.

activities.title: What should Nexus make visible?
activities.description: Add shared sticky notes for useful sustainability information, such as emissions, packaging, or delivery progress.

rounds.title: Customer Obsession: Make Sustainable Delivery Work for Customers

task.goal: Identify how Nexus can meet customer needs while making lower-impact supply-chain choices.
instructions: Choose a customer scenario, such as an urgent delivery, a return, or a request for greener packaging.
Describe what the customer needs and what trade-off a sustainable option might create.
Propose a solution that balances customer value with environmental impact.
Record the customer need, proposed solution, and sustainability benefit as separate, clearly labeled items for host review.

checklist.label: We described a specific customer need.
We proposed a solution that addresses the need.
We explained the solution’s sustainability benefit and any trade-off.

activities.title: What does a customer need from a greener supply chain?
activities.description: Privately share one customer need Nexus should protect while working toward its 2030 goal.

activities.title: How can we make the greener choice customer-first?
activities.description: Post shared ideas for sustainable delivery, packaging, or returns that still work well for customers.

rounds.title: Bias for Action: Run a 2030 Green-Supply-Chain Experiment

task.goal: Turn one promising sustainability idea into a small, measurable next step Nexus can test soon.
instructions: Choose one idea from the earlier rounds or propose a new one.
Define a small experiment Nexus could start within 30 days.
Name an owner role, a first action, and one measure of environmental or customer impact.
Keep the output in the format idea / first action / measure / owner role so the host can track commitments across rooms.

checklist.label: We chose one focused idea to test.
We named a first action and an owner role.
We selected a measure that can show whether the experiment helps.

activities.title: What action can you take?
activities.description: Privately name one action within your influence that could support Nexus’s greenest-supply-chain-by-2030 goal.

activities.title: What should Nexus test next?
activities.description: Post shared experiments with a clear first step and a measurable sustainability or customer outcome.
